title: History & Memory Consolidation
goal: Bring together historical layering, aspectual past contrasts, formal -ra, counterfactuals and witness voice across archives and collective memory.
grammar: Integrated review of Unit 27 grammar and historical vocabulary

items: I can layer historical chronology accurately with active and passive pluperfect forms.
I can distinguish ongoing historical states from archival discoveries, refusals and failed attempts.
I can interpret historiographical *-ra*, counterfactual pluperfect subjunctives and free indirect discourse in essays on memory.
